title: platform-standup-2026-03-30
content:
Date: 2026-03-30
Attendees: Priya Patel (owner), Javier Morales, Ava Chen, Marcus Lee, Keiko Tanaka (joined briefly)
Duration: 25m (quick sync before sprint planning)

Summary / high level
- Small set of action items for control plane rollout and quota throttling.
- Routing policy prototype is in QA; still seeing a small skew in weighted routing metrics.
- Auth service regression surfaced in staging when rotating service-account keys; rollback plan tested.
- Quota enforcement improvements are in review and need one more perf run against spike test.

Individual updates
- Priya: control plane rollout (canary) status
  - Canary batch 1 (5% traffic) completed with no API errors. Metrics: 99.9% success, median p50 latency +8ms vs baseline.
  - Observed occasional 503s when downstream model pool exhausted; implemented auto-fallback to compatible model-variant in the router, PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/512
  - Next: expand canary to 20% Friday if no regressions. Action: run smoketests against dedicated capacity window.

- Javier: routing / policy work
  - Weighted routing prototype merged to staging. Noticed skew in route selection under burst load 1 weights not normalized after fast updates. Root cause suspected race in weights cache TTL. Ticket ENG-3478 created.
  - Temporary mitigation: add short lock on update path; long term: switch to versioned weight sets to avoid in-place mutation.
  - TODO: add unit test for concurrent updates and a load test scenario that mirrors PLG traffic pattern.

- Ava: auth & service-account key rotation
  - Hit a regression in staging: when rotating keys for service-accounts, token exchange endpoint returned 401 for a small percentage of requests during rotation window.
  - Repro steps and logs attached in ENG-3421. Root cause: cache invalidation timing + short TTL on JWKS; rolling update of signer caused mismatch.
  - Fix: increase JWKS TTL to 30s during rotation window and add a staged signer rollout. Patch in review, needs one security review sign-off.

- Marcus: quotas & throttling
  - Quota enforcement prototype reduced tail latency but caused throughput drop on high concurrency tests. Investigating hotspot in quota-store shardleader.
  - Running perf experiments with configurable shard counts; planned to run full spike test tonight (simulate 10k concurrent requests) and report results.
  - Action: coordinate with SRE to run in preprod and collect flamegraphs.

Blockers / risks
- If routing weight normalization bug persists, canary expansion must be halted. Impacts control plane rollout timeline by up to 3 days.
- Auth key rotation regression requires security sign-off before we proceed with customer-facing rotations.
- Quota-store sharding: if we can't scale shardleader, we may need to rethink quota enforcement approach (per-node local counters + sync).

Decisions / notes
- Proceed with canary expansion to 20% Friday morning assuming no new 5xx spikes in the next 48h window. Priya to own go/no-go.
- Temporary mitigation for routing race is acceptable for short term; schedule deeper redesign into next sprint.
- Security to review auth patch by end of day Thursday. Ava to ping on #security if delayed.

Action items (owners)
- Priya: run smoketests for canary expansion + confirm SLA dashboards, due Fri 2026-04-02.
- Javier: add concurrency unit test and push a branch for versioned weight sets, due Mon 2026-03-31.
- Ava: follow up with security on JWKS patch and schedule sign-off, due Thu 2026-04-01.
- Marcus: run quota spike perf tests with SRE and upload flamegraphs, due tonight 2026-03-30.

Follow-ups / parking lot
- Evaluate long-term routing design: versioned weight sets + stronger invariants.
- Consider making JWKS rotation tooling more explicit in release playbook.
- Quota enforcement UX: expose per-route backpressure metrics in Console.

Notes to self / informal
- Saw a couple of flaky test failures in routing CI; probably noise but will keep an eye.
- Reminder: demo for product next Wed; use canary metrics if rollout goes as planned.

Next standup: 2026-03-31 09:30 PT

Linked tickets and PRs referenced in notes:
- ENG-3421 (auth rotation regression)
- ENG-3478 (routing weight normalization race)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/512 (control plane fallback logic)

Attachments / logs: see linked artifacts list and staging logs in Confluence page confluence:platform-control-plane-rollout

End of notes
